goals.objective: 0번 예시 이미지 3개를 카카오톡 채팅에서 이모티콘처럼 쓰기 더 적합한 작은 투명 PNG로 최적화하고, 저장 화면에서 투명 PNG임이 헷갈리지 않도록 표시를 정리한다.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI parsed image dump proves public/students/00/{like,thanks,done}.png are 240x240 RGBA PNGs, transparent at all four corners, each below 120KB, and content alpha bbox remains non-empty.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/kakao-emoticon/evidence/green-assets.json: all three PNGs are 240x240 RGBA, corner alpha [0,0,0,0], under 120KB, non-empty alpha bbox; checker previews generated in same evidence dir | cleanup: no runtime spawned for CLI image parse

successCriteria.scenario: Browser QA opens /student/0 on a local Vite preview and asserts three cards render, no '크게 보기' link exists, and each rendered image reports naturalWidth/naturalHeight 240 with currentSrc under /students/00/.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/kakao-emoticon/evidence/browser-qa.json and student-0.png: /student/0 has 3 cards, 0 large-view links, all images natural/rendered 240x240 under /students/00/ | cleanup: stopped Vite session 42174; lsof -i :5174 empty; browser closed

successCriteria.scenario: npm run build completes after the asset/CSS changes and the temporary QA runtime leaves no Playwright dependency installed.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/kakao-emoticon/evidence/build.txt: npm run build completed; playwright-cleanup.txt shows npm ls playwright --depth=0 empty | cleanup: npm uninstall --no-save playwright completed; lsof -i :5174 empty

goals.evidence: C001 green-assets.json; C002 browser-qa.json + student-0.png; C003 build.txt + playwright-cleanup.txt all passed with cleanup receipts.
